findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "size_expansion_vessel" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Size the expansion vessel and pressurisation of a closed heating or chilled-water circuit to EN 12828: static height, minimum pressure p0, fill pressure pa, fin…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "size_expansion_vessel" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
